<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Centered Circle</title>
  <style>
    * {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
    }
    svg {
      width: 400px;
      height: 400px;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 10px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2));
    }
    circle {
      fill: white;
      transition: fill 0.3s ease;
    }
    circle:hover {
      fill: #e0e0e0;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <svg viewBox="0 0 400 400" role="img" aria-label="A centered circle">
    <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="200"/>
  </svg>
</body>
</html>

2. **Better viewport handling** - Changed from `100vw` to `100%` to avoid scrollbars
3. **Visual styling** - Added a gradient background and drop shadow for depth
4. **Interactivity** - Added a hover effect that changes the circle's color
5. **Accessibility** - Added `role="img"` and `aria-label` to the SVG for screen readers
6. **Cleaner naming** - Changed the cryptic "ae683f770" title to "Centered Circle" and removed the unnecessary ID
7. **Better CSS** - Added `box-sizing: border-box` for more predictable layout

The page now displays a white circle with a nice purple gradient background and subtle animations on hover.
